## ad-versions errors
Set as the error workflow of **ad-versions**. Writes `runs/<id>/error.json` (node, message, time), then sends a Telegram message (credential `telegram-demo`, chat id from `data/config/telegram.json`): run id, failing node, message (300 characters, token-scrubbed), and writes error.json again with `telegram`: `sent`, `failed: <reason>` or `skipped: no chat id` (no call is made when the chat id cannot be read). The Telegram steps continue on error: this workflow has no error workflow of its own, so a failed send must end here, not loop. The failing execution's id is the run id; a failure in the trigger itself has none and gets `trigger-<timestamp>`.

**Pod clean-up** (only when the failing node is in the live b-roll branch, `B-roll live: ...`): its own branch from `Error: ids`, above the run folder, so a down media service or a full disk cannot stop it. It deletes only the pod `runs/<id>/pod.json` says this run deployed (by name, or by launch time when the deploy never answered) and only if `GET /api/pods` shows that same pod, retrying every 30 s for 10 minutes while the pod is still launching; a pod it did not deploy is left alone. The outcome is `pod_cleanup` in error.json and a line in the Telegram message.

Error: is there a pod to delete?
